name: CrossFit Programming
start: cd /workspace; if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:6419; then echo 'grip preview already running on :6419'; exit 0; fi; nohup python3 -m grip . 0.0.0.0:6419 > /tmp/grip-preview.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:6419; then echo 'grip preview ready on :6419'; exit 0; fi; sleep 1; done; echo 'grip preview failed to start'; cat /tmp/grip-preview.log; exit 1
